  "table_summary": "The table reports mean F1 score (with mean precision, mean recall and overall accuracy) for plant disease detection under 60 experimental configurations spanning two CNNs (AlexNet, GoogLeNet), two training regimes (transfer learning vs. from scratch), five train/test splits (20/80 up to 80/20), and three image types (color, grayscale, segmented). Transfer learning, color input, and larger training sets all yield systematically higher scores, with precision, recall and accuracy closely tracking the F1 values in every cell."
